[SWS_CORE_90020]
⌊
DRAFT
g ⌈
If functionality is called that depends on prior initial-
ization via
ara::core::Initialize
and
ara::core::Initialize
has not been
called, the Functional Cluster implementation shall treat this as a
Violation
.
⌋
(RS_-
AP_00111)
The rationale to treat this as a
Violation
is that it cannot be handled by the caller of
the API at the point in time where the error is detected. Aborting execution is the only
way to signal this kind of systematic error and prevent later failures.
